questions.q: What is a Power BI workspace?
options: A collaborative container in the service where a team's dashboards, reports, semantic models, and other Fabric items live together
A feature available only inside Power BI Desktop
A single report page with multiple visuals
A folder on your local hard drive for storing .pbix files
questions.explain: A workspace is the collaborative unit everything else builds on: reports get published into it, apps get packaged from it, and access gets granted to it.

questions.q: Where can you create a new workspace?
options: Only inside Power BI Desktop
Only in the Power BI service (browser, app.powerbi.com) — Power BI Desktop has no workspace creation screen
Only through the Windows admin control panel
Equally in both Desktop and the service
questions.explain: As Lesson 67 covered, workspace creation is entirely a service-side concept. Desktop can publish into an existing workspace but never creates one.

questions.q: Which workspace role can publish and edit content but CANNOT manage who else has access?
options: Contributor
There is no such role — every role can manage access
Viewer
Admin
questions.explain: Contributors can add, edit, and publish content, but managing member/role access is reserved for Admins (and, to a lesser extent, Members).

questions.q: What happens when a workspace Admin deletes a workspace?
options: The workspace is archived and can be restored within 30 days
Only the workspace name is removed; content moves to 'My Workspace'
Every dashboard, report, semantic model, and dataflow inside it is permanently removed, with no way to undo it
Nothing happens until every member individually confirms
questions.explain: Deleting a workspace is genuinely permanent — there's no recycle bin or recovery option for its contents.

questions.q: What is the default contact list for a new workspace?
options: Only the person who created the workspace, even if other admins are added later
Every user in the organization
The workspace admins
No one — a contact list must always be set manually before saving
questions.explain: By default, workspace admins receive notifications about issues; you can override this to a specific list of users or groups under Advanced settings.
